name: Single-Bay Portal Frame (Office Gravity)
prompt: Create a 2D 1-bay 1-story RC portal frame with a span of 6.0 m and height of 3.5 m with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa, tributary width 4.0 m) and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver beam and column cross-sections that satisfy ACI 318-25 strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0), and generate production CAD DXF drawings saved to 'research_paper/drawings/A01_portal_frame.dxf'.

name: Wide-Span Portal Frame (Storage Loading)
prompt: Create a 2D 1-bay 1-story RC frame with an 8.0 m span and 4.0 m column height with fixed base supports. Apply heavy storage gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 11.97 kPa, tributary width 4.5 m) and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver beam and column cross-sections that satisfy ACI 318-25 strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: 2-Bay 2-Story RC Moment Frame (Office)
prompt: Build a 2D 2-bay 2-story RC moment frame with 5.0 m bay widths and 3.2 m story heights with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa, tributary width 5.0 m) and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver beam and column cross-sections that satisfy ACI 318-25 strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: 2-Bay 3-Story Frame (Residential Gravity)
prompt: Model a 2D 2-bay 3-story concrete frame with 6.0 m bay widths and 3.0 m story heights with fixed base supports. Apply residential gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 1.92 kPa, tributary width 4.5 m) and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver beam and column cross-sections that satisfy ACI 318-25 strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: 2D Multi-Story Modal Eigenvalue Analysis
prompt: Create a 2D 2-bay 3-story RC frame (6.0 m bays, 3.5 m story heights, columns 0.40m x 0.40m, beams 0.30m x 0.50m) with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa, tributary width 4.5 m) to define story masses (seismic weight = self-weight + superimposed dead), run eigenvalue modal analysis for the first 3 modes, and inspect the fundamental vibration periods (T1, T2, T3) and modal mass participation ratio.

name: 2D Response Spectrum Analysis (ASCE 7 Design Spectrum)
prompt: Create a 2D 2-bay 3-story RC frame (6.0 m spans, 3.5 m stories) with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa, tributary width 4.5 m), execute Response Spectrum Analysis along the X direction with ASCE 7-22 design spectrum parameters (SDS = 1.0g, SD1 = 0.6g, R = 5.0, Ie = 1.0, 5% damping) using CQC modal combination, and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver beam and column cross-sections that satisfy ACI 318-25 strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: 2D Dynamic Response Spectrum from Ground Motion Record
prompt: Build a 2D 3-bay 4-story RC frame with 5.5 m bays and 3.5 m stories with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa, tributary width 4.5 m), execute Response Spectrum Analysis along the X direction using the 5%-damped response spectrum computed from the 1994 Northridge earthquake ground motion record (Sylmar station, R = 5.0, Ie = 1.0) with CQC modal combination, and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver beam and column cross-sections that satisfy ACI 318-25 strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: Self-Healing Reflection: Overstressed 2D Frame Resizing
prompt: Create a 2D 1-bay 1-story frame (span 7.0 m, height 3.5 m, fixed base supports) initialized with preliminary trial sections: columns 0.30m x 0.30m and beams 0.30m x 0.45m. Apply heavy storage gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 11.97 kPa, tributary width 6.0 m) and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver final beam and column cross-sections that satisfy ACI 318-25 strength requirements, revising the preliminary trial sizes if necessary so all members satisfy governing DCR <= 1.0, and generate production CAD DXF drawings saved to 'research_paper/drawings/A08_portal_frame.dxf'.

name: 3D Space Frame (2x2, 2-Story Gravity)
prompt: Create a 3D 2-bay by 2-bay 2-story space frame (6.0 m bay widths in X and Y, 3.5 m story heights, columns 0.40m x 0.40m, beams 0.30m x 0.50m) with fixed base supports. Apply residential gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 1.92 kPa) distributed across two-way floor panels, assemble factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22, validate the 3D model, run linear static structural analysis, and inspect support reactions and internal member forces.

name: 3D Space Frame (3x2 Bay, 3-Story Commercial Gravity)
prompt: Construct a 3D 3-bay by 2-bay 3-story concrete space frame with 5.0 m bays along X, 6.0 m bays along Y, and 3.2 m story heights with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa) distributed across floor slabs, assemble factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22, and deliver beam and column cross-sections satisfying ACI 318-25 strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: 3D Space Frame Equivalent Lateral Force Seismic (Near Code Limit)
prompt: Build a 3D 2-bay by 2-bay 3-story space frame (bay width 6.0 m in X and Y, story height 3.5 m) with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa) and ASCE 7-22 Equivalent Lateral Force (ELF) seismic loads with SDS = 1.2g, SD1 = 0.5g, and R = 5.0. Generate factored LRFD seismic load combinations per ASCE 7-22, validate the model, and deliver beam and column cross-sections satisfying ACI 318-25 biaxial P-M and shear requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: 3D Space Frame Modal Eigenvalue Analysis
prompt: Create a 3D 2-bay by 2-bay 3-story space frame (6.0 m bays in X and Y, 3.5 m stories, columns 0.45m x 0.45m, beams 0.30m x 0.50m) with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa) to define floor seismic masses (mass = self-weight + superimposed dead), run 3D eigenvalue modal analysis, and inspect the fundamental vibration periods, frequencies, and modal participation factors for the first 3 modes.

name: 3D Response Spectrum Analysis (ASCE 7 Spectrum)
prompt: Build a 3D 2-bay by 2-bay 3-story space frame (6.0 m bays in X and Y, 3.5 m stories) with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa), execute 3D Response Spectrum Analysis (RSA) along the X direction using ASCE 7-22 design spectrum parameters (SDS = 1.1g, SD1 = 0.55g, R = 5.0, 5% damping) with CQC modal combination, and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver beam and column cross-sections satisfying ACI 318-25 biaxial strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: 3D Space Frame Response Spectrum Analysis (El Centro Spectrum)
prompt: Construct a 3D 3-bay by 2-bay 3-story space frame (5.0 m bays in X, 6.0 m bays in Y, 3.2 m story heights) with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa), perform Response Spectrum Analysis along the X direction using the 1940 El Centro response spectrum (R = 5.0, 5% damping) with CQC modal combination, and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Inspect dynamic modal participation and deliver beam and column cross-sections satisfying ACI 318-25 strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: Self-Healing Reflection: 3D High-Seismic Redesign
prompt: Create a 3D 2-bay by 2-bay 2-story space frame (6.0 m bays in X and Y, 3.5 m stories) with fixed base supports, initialized with preliminary trial sections: columns 0.25m x 0.25m and beams 0.25m x 0.35m. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa) and ASCE 7-22 seismic ELF lateral loads (SDS = 1.2g, SD1 = 0.5g, R = 5.0), and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver final beam and column cross-sections that satisfy ACI 318-25 strength requirements, revising the preliminary trial sizes if necessary so that governing DCR <= 1.0.

name: 3D Space Frame Bi-Directional Orthogonal Seismic Design
prompt: Build a 3D 2-bay by 2-bay 3-story space frame (6.0 m bays in X and Y, 3.5 m stories) with fixed base supports subjected to bi-directional seismic demands. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa) and ASCE 7-22 lateral seismic forces (SDS = 1.0g, SD1 = 0.4g, R = 5.0). Generate factored LRFD load combinations under orthogonal ASCE 7-22 directional combinations (1.0 Ex + 0.3 Ey and 0.3 Ex + 1.0 Ey), and deliver beam and column cross-sections satisfying ACI 318-25 strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: Earthquake Time-History Elastic Demand Check (1940 El Centro)
prompt: Create a 2D 2-bay 3-story RC moment frame (6.0 m bays, 3.5 m stories, columns 0.50m x 0.50m, beams 0.35m x 0.55m) with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa, tributary width 5.0 m) to define story masses, and conduct dynamic earthquake time-history analysis under the 1940 El Centro ground motion record (Imperial Valley earthquake, component S00E) along the X direction with 5% modal damping using Newmark-Beta integration. Inspect the elastic dynamic response, reporting peak roof displacement and peak base shear demand.

name: 3D Earthquake Time-History Dynamic Integration (1994 Northridge)
prompt: Create a 3D 2-bay by 2-bay 2-story space frame (6.0 m bays in X and Y, 3.5 m stories, columns 0.50m x 0.50m, beams 0.35m x 0.55m) with fixed base supports. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa) to establish story masses, and perform direct dynamic time-history numerical integration under the 1994 Northridge ground motion record (Sylmar station, component 360) along the X direction with 5% modal damping. Inspect the roof displacement history and peak base shear demand.

name: CSI SAP2000 CAE Round-Trip Interoperability
prompt: Ingest the 3D RC seismic frame model from the CSI SAP2000 fixture file 'research_paper/benchmarks/fixtures/exported_seismic_frame.s2k'. Validate the imported framing geometry and boundary conditions, execute structural analysis under gravity and seismic demands, and report: (1) total structural self-weight and total dead load (in kN), (2) ASCE 7-22 lateral seismic base shear under load case 'EQx' (in kN), and (3) the first three natural vibration periods (T1, T2, T3 in seconds). Re-export the verified model back to CSI SAP2000 text format as 'research_paper/benchmarks/results/exported_sap2000.s2k'.

name: CSI ETABS CAE Round-Trip Interoperability
prompt: Ingest the 3D RC space frame model from the CSI ETABS fixture file 'research_paper/benchmarks/fixtures/exported_seismic_frame.e2k'. Validate the imported framing geometry and boundary conditions, execute structural analysis under gravity and seismic demands, and report: (1) total structural self-weight and total dead load (in kN), (2) ASCE 7-22 lateral seismic base shear under load case 'EQx' (in kN), and (3) the first three natural vibration periods (T1, T2, T3 in seconds). Re-export the verified model back to CSI ETABS text format as 'research_paper/benchmarks/results/exported_etabs.e2k'.

name: Architectural Floor Plan Draft Ingestion (3-Story RC School Building)
prompt: Examine the attached architectural floor plan drawing for the 3-story school building ('research_paper/benchmarks/fixtures/floor_plan_3story_school.PNG') with 3.5 m story heights. Extract the structural column layout and framing grid (Grids A, B, C, D and 1, 2, 3, 4), compile the complete 3D structural frame model with fixed base boundary conditions, validate topological connectivity, and inspect the resulting project.

name: Multimodal Floor Plan to Code-Compliant Seismic Design (4-Story Commercial Mall)
prompt: Execute the end-to-end multimodal floor-plan-to-seismic design workflow on the attached architectural floor plan for the 4-story commercial mall building ('research_paper/benchmarks/fixtures/mall_plan_4story.PNG'): extract the structural grid lines (Grids 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 along X and A, B, C, D along Y) and 4 story elevations (3.2 m each) into a plan draft, and compile the 3D structural frame. Apply retail gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 4.79 kPa) and ASCE 7-22 seismic ELF lateral loads (SDS = 1.2g, SD1 = 0.5g, R = 5.0), generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22, execute 3D finite element analysis, and deliver beam and column cross-sections satisfying ACI 318-25 strength requirements (governing DCR <= 1.0).

name: Dynamic Self-Healing Reflection: Overstressed Frame Resizing
prompt: Construct a 2D 2-bay 3-story moment frame (6.0 m bays, 3.5 m stories) with fixed base supports, initialized with preliminary trial sections: columns 0.30m x 0.30m and beams 0.30m x 0.45m. Apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa, tributary width 5.0 m) and ASCE 7-22 high-seismic lateral loads (SDS = 1.5g, SD1 = 0.75g, R = 5.0), and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver final beam and column cross-sections that satisfy ACI 318-25 strength requirements, revising the preliminary trial sizes if necessary so that all members satisfy governing DCR <= 1.0.

name: Autonomous Seismic Design-to-CAD Production Pipeline
prompt: Execute the full autonomous seismic engineering pipeline: build a 2D 2-bay 2-story office frame (5.0 m bays, 3.2 m stories) with fixed base supports, apply office gravity loads (superimposed dead 1.5 kPa, live 3.12 kPa, tributary width 5.0 m), run Response Spectrum Analysis with ASCE 7-22 design spectrum parameters (SDS = 1.0g, SD1 = 0.6g, R = 5.0, 5% damping) along the X direction with CQC modal combination, and generate factored LRFD load combinations per ASCE 7-22. Deliver beam and column cross-sections satisfying ACI 318-25 strength requirements (revising member sizes if necessary so DCR <= 1.0), generate production AutoCAD DXF drawings with rebar schedules saved to 'research_paper/drawings/C08_seismic_frame.dxf', and inspect the detailing results.
